name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project, located in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. Diablillos is one of the world's largest undeveloped primary silver resources, with Measured & Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold across 232 million tonnes. The company has completed a definitive feasibility study and received environmental approvals, targeting first production in 2029.
